scans.name: HOLYGRAIL (GM Signal)
scans.about: GM Hollygrail long term: higher highs and rising OHLC 3 days, EMA20 > EMA60, RSI14 >= 60; results go to the 3️⃣HOLYGRAIL watchlist

scans.name: MULTIBAGGER (Momentum)
scans.about: Weekly close at a fresh 52-week high after 5 weeks below it, mcap >= 500 Cr, good liquidity; results go to the 4️⃣MULTIBAGGER watchlist

scans.name: Top MSWING
scans.about: Ranking by the trader's Homma MSWING score (custom indicator ^12017), highest first, among liquid stocks with mcap >= 500 Cr. Only the top N are kept; 'new' means newly entered the top N. Rank and score are given per stock.

scans.name: ROE/EPS IMPROVING
scans.about: Fundamental scan: net profit up year-on-year for 3 straight quarters, latest quarter profit +20% and sales +10% YoY, mcap > 500 Cr. A stock entering usually follows a new quarterly result
